Since that introduction, NSA Architects has successfully executed Phase 1 and Phase 2 of the Oshiwara Flagship Store, delivered Phase 1 of the Borivali Store, and efficiently coordinated the successful completion of Phase 3 – the main interior works.

What stands out is not just the design language, but the discipline behind it. Retail execution demands structured coordination, vendor control, timeline integrity, and brand consistency — and NSA delivered on all fronts.

The Oshiwara flagship today reflects a clean, premium, experience-led format that aligns perfectly with the Rings & I growth vision.

If I were to describe NSA Architects’ contribution in three words:

PRECISION | ACCOUNTABILITY | SCALE-READY EXECUTION

featured_reviews.name: Sujal Raut
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wonderful experience working with DSC Architects for the interior design of our 2.5 BHK flat. Deepti and Siddhesh Chogle were extremely professional, creative, and attentive to our needs. From planning to execution—including some civil work—they managed everything smoothly and with great attention to detail. The final outcome exceeded our expectations, and our home now feels both functional and beautifully designed. Highly recommended!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much

featured_reviews.name: Archana Ved
featured_reviews.review_text:
We consider ourselves fortunate to have found Siddesh and Deepti  Chogle (DSC)for our house job. Siddesh is a very calm person he listened intently and was empathetic towards the specific requirements of each member of the family. Deepti was extremely innovative and creative  while designing the layout and concept. At each stage they were fully  involved during material selection to even discussing smallest details with regards to execution of the project. It is a 2.5 BHK flat and each of the room is customized to meet our requirements. The color palette choosen by them is very subtle.
Siddesh and Deepti replied to our unending queries with patience and insightful ideas. We are very happy with the quality of the material used and the finishes. They have also ensured that the overall cost does not increase. They didn't just offer solutions but presented us with range of alternatives to find a perfect fit for our style and budget.
Good work from their whole team and keep it up.We would definitely recommend them to anyone!!!!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much ma’am

featured_reviews.name: Pratima Bhoslay
featured_reviews.review_text: Very satisfying experience interacting with Siddhesh and his team. Twice we have got our place done up by the team. They stick to their schedule without compromising on quality of work. they have a skilled team of carpenters, etc

featured_reviews.review_text: We had an excellent experience right from designing to execution in renovation our home. The attention to details is at a different level. We wholeheartedly recommend DSC Architects & Interiors for those who are looking to renovate their homes!!
